fields.h1: Build Education Workflow Automation for the School Front Office
fields.hero_description: Build education workflow automation that follows up on unexplained absences and books a substitute before the first bell.
fields.features_heading: What Emergent Builds Into a School Office App
fields.features_subheading: Each flow runs on the rules your office already follows, and every case those rules cannot settle lands with one named staff member.
fields.feature_1:
Rules written the way the handbook reads

Describe a rule in plain English, such as who hears about an absence nobody explains. Emergent builds the app, its database, and the logic, and a new prompt changes any rule.
fields.feature_2:
Connects to the systems the office runs

The app connects to any tool with an API. A student information system with an API can feed attendance in and take updates back. Slack and email connect the same way.
fields.feature_3:
Family forms that work on a phone

Enrollment packets and permission slips ask one question per screen, so a guardian can finish one at school pickup. The app saves the signature with the student record.
fields.feature_4:
Every exception has one owner

An unanswered absence email or an uncovered class goes to one named staff member by email, Slack, or in the app. If nobody acts, a reminder follows, then an escalation.
fields.feature_5:
Paper forms read into fields

Scan a paper form a family hands in, and AI reads the student name, the guardian, and the phone number into fields. A low-confidence field waits for the registrar to check.
fields.feature_6:
Student records in a database you own

Records sit in a database you own, and paid plans export the full code to your GitHub repository. With no task cap, the first week of school runs like any other week.

fields.usecase_heading: Four School Office Flows to Run This Term
fields.tab_content_1:
No reply by 11:00 a.m. puts the absence in front of the clerk

Tavi Okafor-Brennan is marked absent at Calloway Brook School at 8:15 a.m. with no note on file. At 8:45 a.m., the app emails his guardian, Rosalind Okafor-Brennan, a one-question form. No reply comes by 11:00 a.m., so Desmond Ilunga-Park, the attendance clerk, gets an in-app alert with an Open record button.
fields.tab_content_2:
A new family finishes enrollment from a phone

Marisol Achterberg-Nwosu enrolls her daughter, Pia, in fourth grade with a packet that asks one question per screen. She adds 2 emergency contacts and signs the handbook acknowledgment on her phone. The app marks Pia Enrolled, places her in homeroom 4B, and adds her to Ignatius Veldkamp-Rao's roster.
fields.tab_content_3:
Each unsigned slip gets its own reminder

Two days before Thursday's science museum trip, 23 of 26 permission slips are signed. The app emails each of the 3 guardians who have not signed a reminder with a link to the slip. Henrietta Szabo-Mbeki, the trip lead, gets the 3 names in the app, each marked Not signed.
fields.tab_content_4:
A substitute takes all 5 classes by 6:20 a.m.

At 6:05 a.m., Bartholomew Achebe-Strand reports he is sick on the staff absence form. The app offers his 5 classes to the substitute list in the order the office set. Linnea Castellanos-Moyo accepts at 6:20 a.m. The app emails her room 214 and the lesson plan, and the front office board shows his classes Covered.

fields.howto_title: How to Build Education Workflow Automation
fields.howto_description: These 7 steps turn your office's paperwork into tested rules and launch education workflow automation one flow at a time.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Log one week of office paperwork
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Find the record behind each step
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Pick one staff member per exception
fields.howto_step_1_des: For one school week, have the front office write down every task done by hand, from the morning absence calls to the last permission slip chased at pickup. Circle the tasks that follow the same rule every time, and build those first.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Note which system holds each record at your school, for example attendance in the student information system and trip rosters in a spreadsheet. Connect each one through its API. Every rule should read the record the office already trusts.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Write each rule as you would explain it to a new office hire: flag a student who misses 3 days in a row, and remind a teacher whose grades are due Friday. Emergent builds the app and its logic from those sentences.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Decide before launch who hears about each exception: the attendance clerk for an unexplained absence, the registrar for an unclear form field, the assistant principal when no substitute accepts by 7:00 a.m. Set a reminder for when nobody acts.
fields.howto_step_5_des: Before a single family gets an email, run last month's attendance and staff absences through the app. Compare each flagged absence with what the clerk logged by hand, then adjust the rule in a prompt and replay the month.
fields.howto_step_6_title: 06 Start with a flow only staff see
fields.howto_step_6_des: Turn on substitute cover first, because it reaches staff and substitutes but no families. Watch it for 2 weeks. Add absence notes next, then enrollment packets and permission slips once guardian contact details are clean.
fields.howto_step_7_des: At the end of each term, read every case a person had to fix by hand: absences closed by phone, forms retyped, classes covered by calls. Change the rule behind each repeat with a prompt, and check whether the list is shorter next term.

faq_plan.a: Education workflow automation is the use of technology to streamline and automate repetitive administrative tasks at a school or college. Staff then handle only the cases a rule cannot settle, such as an absence no guardian explains.

faq_plan.q: How do I set up education workflow automation?
faq_plan.a: Pick one office task that runs on a fixed rule and describe it in a prompt to Emergent's AI automation builder, which turns it into a working app. Connect the system that holds the records through its API, and switch the rule on once its results match what staff did by hand.

faq_plan.q: How much work does school workflow automation add for teachers?
faq_plan.a: It should add almost none, if the rules start from records teachers already keep, such as the attendance they take each morning. Ask for one new habit at most, like reporting a sick day on a form instead of calling the office. Then show teachers the result: an app built on Emergent can tell them by email or in Slack which substitute accepted.

faq_plan.q: Can a college use education workflow automation for dorm maintenance requests?
faq_plan.a: Yes. A student reports the problem on a form with the hall and room number, the app routes it to the right maintenance team, and the student gets an email when the ticket closes. The pattern is the same one tenant requests follow in property management automation. Send anything a student marks urgent to the on-call staff member at once.

faq_plan.q: Where should student records live in education workflow automation?
faq_plan.a: In one database the school controls, with each staff member able to see only the records their job needs. Under FERPA, parents have the right to some control over the disclosure of personally identifiable information from the education records. Ask the person who handles student privacy at your school to review who can see what before launch.

faq_plan.q: How does education workflow automation avoid emailing the wrong guardian?
faq_plan.a: It checks a flag on the student record before each email goes out. Store every guardian with a flag for which notices they may receive, and update it the day the office learns of a change, not at the next enrollment. Before launch, send a test batch to staff addresses and check every recipient by hand.

faq_plan.q: Can education workflow automation schedule parent-teacher conferences?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Teachers open their time slots, guardians pick one on a form, and the app emails a confirmation and a reminder the day before. Booking and reminders work the way appointment flows do in healthcare automation. Hold back a few evening slots for families who cannot come during the school day.

faq_plan.q: Can education workflow automation route teacher supply requests?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Set a dollar threshold that matches your purchasing policy: requests under it go straight to the office manager to order, and requests over it wait for the principal. The teacher enters the item, the cost, and the class on one form and gets an email with the decision. Emergent builds the form, the routing logic, and a dashboard of open requests from a plain-English prompt.

faq_plan.q: Can education workflow automation handle forms families fill out on paper?
faq_plan.a: Yes. Scan the form, and the app reads the fields into the student record, with any unclear value held for a staff member to check. Keep the paper form in the same order as the online one. Then both versions fill the same fields. Data from both lives in a database you own when the app is built on Emergent.

faq_plan.q: Can education workflow automation run college move-in day?
faq_plan.a: Send each student a check-in link with a move-in time slot before they arrive, and have the app mark the room Occupied when the student picks up the key. The flow mirrors online check-in in hotel automation, where a guest finishes the paperwork before reaching the desk. Spread the time slots across the day so each hall gets a steady stream of arrivals.

plan.angle: The top results are vendor blogs that define education workflow automation and list tasks it can cover (attendance, enrollment, scheduling) without showing a single flow running. This page shows four at one K-8 school, Calloway Brook School, as working screens a front office can copy: an unexplained absence that reaches the attendance clerk, an enrollment packet a new family finishes on a phone, permission slips chased before a field trip, and a substitute booked before school opens. The FAQ answers the questions an office manager or registrar asks before building one, from where student data lives to paper forms and move-in day.
